title: Vision examples now cover local images
summary:
A documentation-and-community day: clearer Vision examples, a sharper text API description, and VibeCoder in the creative app listings.

The API docs added Python and JavaScript examples for sending local JPEGs as base64 data URLs to the Vision API, alongside the existing image URL approach.

The docs now specify that the OpenAI-compatible text API currently supports only the completion endpoint.

VibeCoder, a Pollinations-powered web app for coding without writing syntax, was added to the README and website creative app lists.
